'''420''' ('''four hundred [and] twenty''') is the [[natural number]] following 419 and preceding 421.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Vanovschi |first=Vitalii |title=Properties of the number 420 |url=http://www.numberempire.com:80/420 |access-date=2026-09-16 |website=www.numberempire.com |language=en}}</ref>

== In mathematics ==
420 is a [[Root of a function|zero]] of the [[Mertens function]],<ref>{{Cite OEIS|A028442|Numbers n such that Mertens' function is zero}}</ref> a [[sparsely totient number|sparsely totient]] number,<ref>{{Cite OEIS|A036913|Sparsely totient numbers}}</ref> a [[pronic number]],<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite OEIS|A002378|Oblong (or promic, pronic, or heteromecic) numbers}}</ref> a balanced number,<ref>{{cite OEIS|A020492|Balanced numbers: numbers k such that phi(k) (A000010) divides sigma(k) (A000203)}}</ref> a [[largely composite number]],<ref>{{Cite OEIS|A067128|Ramanujan's largely composite numbers}}</ref> and a [[cluster prime]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Weisstein |first=Eric W. |title=Cluster Prime |url=https://mathworld.wolfram.com/ClusterPrime.html |access-date=2026-09-16 |website=mathworld.wolfram.com |publisher=Wolfram Research, Inc. |language=en}}</ref>

420 is the number of [[minimal cover]]s on 7 objects with 6 members.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Weisstein |first=Eric W. |title=Minimal Cover |url=https://mathworld.wolfram.com/MinimalCover.html |access-date=2026-09-16 |website=mathworld.wolfram.com |publisher=Wolfram Research, Inc. |language=en}}</ref>

=== Divisors ===
The [[Divisor|divisors]] of 420 is 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10, 12, 14, 15, 20, 21, 28, 30, 35, 42, 60, 70, 84, 105, 140, 210, and 420.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Factors of 420 - Find Prime Factorization/Factors of 420 |url=https://www.cuemath.com/numbers/factors-of-420/ |access-date=2026-09-16 |website=Cuemath |language=en}}</ref> Because the first seven divisors is going from 1 to 7, it is the smallest number that is divisible by 1 through 7.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Friedman |first1=Erich |title=What's Special About This Number? |url=https://erich-friedman.github.io/numbers.html |website=erich-friedman.github.io |access-date=2026-09-16}}</ref><ref>{{cite OEIS|A003418|Least common multiple (or LCM) of {1, 2, ..., n} for n >{{=}} 1, a(0) {{=}} 1}}</ref>

== In other fields ==
[[420 (cannabis culture)|420]] (pronounced four-twenty) is a [[cannabis culture]] slang for [[cannabis consumption]].<ref>{{cite web |date=April 20, 2000 |title=Stoner Chic Traces Origin To San Rafael – Snickering high schoolers brought '420' into lexicon |url=http://www.sfgate.com/cgi-bin/article.cgi?f=/c/a/2000/04/20/MN101165.DTL |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120527171359/http://www.sfgate.com/cgi-bin/article.cgi?f=/c/a/2000/04/20/MN101165.DTL |archive-date=May 27, 2012 |access-date=April 4, 2012 |work=[[San Francisco Chronicle]]}}</ref>
